content: Silence is the sacred sanctuary of the soul; speech is the noisy marketplace of human opinion.
author: Persian Proverbs
explanation: In the bustling bazaar of human words, opinions are bought, sold, bargained, and discarded like cheap tin. But when you close your lips and retreat into the quiet inner chamber of consciousness, you enter a sanctuary where divine truth whispers without words.
practicalInsight: Spend fifteen minutes in total silence after lunch today. Step out of the marketplace of noise.
reflectionPrompt: How often do you allow your soul to rest in the sanctuary of total silence?
